text: 随着10月进入尾声，全球金融市场与科技行业迎来今年最为关键的“超级大周”。从中国政经大事到美欧日四大央行密集决议，从美国三季度GDP、核心PCE等重量级经济数据发布，到科技巨头财报与苹果秋季发布会的重磅登场，未来一周的信息量将迎来全面爆发。以下是格隆汇为您梳理未来一周(10月26日—10月31日(不可错过的核心大事件与重要日程，助您提前布局、精准把握市场脉搏。 <u>10月26日(周一)：</u> 上交所/中证指数修订上证系列指数正式实施； 第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议召开； 欧洲多国开始实施冬令时，欧股交易时间为北京时间16:00-次日00:30；
text_en: As October draws to a close, global financial markets and the technology industry usher in this year's most critical "super week." From major Chinese political and economic events to intensive decisions by four major central banks in the US, Europe, and Japan, from the release of heavyweight economic data such as US third-quarter GDP and core PCE to the high-profile appearances of tech giant earnings and Apple's fall launch event, the coming week will see a full-scale explosion of information. Below are the core must-see events and important schedules for the coming week (October 26-31) compiled by Gelonghui to help you plan ahead and accurately grasp the market pulse. <u>October 26 (Monday):</u> The revised SSE series indices by the Shanghai Stock Exchange/China Securities Index Co. officially take effect; the Fifth Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee is convened; multiple European countries begin implementing winter time, with European stock trading hours at Beijing time 16:00-00:30 the next day;
